summary: Server proxy of a distant sound: written by esv::sound::DistantSoundSystem (CreateDistantSoundInfo, Update, FinalizeDistantSoundState), read by ServerSoundHelper::GetPlaySoundContextType. Up to 8 holders in idle levels.

fields.name: Name
fields.evidence: Same layout as eoc::sound::DistantSoundInfo (macOS FieldMeta m_Name; SE Coverage.h DistantSoundInfo); FinalizeDistantSoundState copies proxy +0x48 into the state component's Name.

fields.name: InitSound
fields.evidence: eoc::sound::DistantSoundInfo m_InitSound; live 0xFFFFFFFF (null FixedString) at proxy +0x50.

fields.name: EntityUUID
fields.evidence: eoc::sound::DistantSoundInfo m_EntityUUID; live random 16 bytes at proxy +0x58; FinalizeDistantSoundState copies proxy +0x58.

fields.name: Switches
fields.evidence: eoc::sound::DistantSoundInfo m_Switches; FinalizeDistantSoundState copies the values array at proxy +0x98 (= +0x20 + 0x30) as FixedStrings. Live: 8-element key/value arrays.

fields.name: ActivationRange
fields.evidence: eoc::sound::DistantSoundInfo m_ActivationRange; FinalizeDistantSoundState reads proxy +0xA8. Live 60/65/150/200.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2E3D210 (FUN_142e3df60 constructs 0xB0 bytes) stores its handle argument at +0. Live: 48 distinct entity handles. Probably the real sound entity the proxy stands for.

fields.name: UserProxies
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x4D69E0 (DistantSoundSystem::FinalizeDistantSoundState) inserts a net::UserID into the key set at proxy+8 (FUN_180274920, the HashSet<UserID> insert), grows the value array at +0x38 with 8-byte elements ('IndexedStorage<ID<EntityHandleTraits>>') and stores the per-user state-proxy entity. Live: 1 key, 1 value.

fields.name: Info
fields.evidence: A copy of eoc::sound::DistantSoundInfo (0x68 bytes): FinalizeDistantSoundState reads FixedString +0x48, Guid +0x58, Switches values +0x98, float +0xA8, byte +0xAC of the proxy (local lVar20/lVar18) and writes them into the state component in DistantSoundInfo order. Live samples match (FixedStrings at +0x48/+0x4C, null at +0x50, HashMap at +0x68, ranges 60..200 at +0xA8).

open_questions: Exact role of the handle at +0 (source sound entity assumed).
